subject: VaultBank: security evidence timeline, DPA redlines, and retention checklist
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Timothy Lowe <timothy.lowe@vaultbank.com>, Sara Kim <sara.kim@vaultbank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: VaultBank: security evidence timeline, DPA redlines, and retention checklist

Hi Timothy / Sara —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side, plus concrete next steps so we can keep this moving toward your security review window next month. High-level takeaways we heard: 

- Primary acceptance criteria: SOC 2 alignment for data-at-rest/encryption, tamper-evident audit logs with 7+ years export capability, and contract language (DPA) that limits processing and includes a 30‑day breach notification SLA.
- Pen test: VaultBank prefers vendor-supplied report or a redacted executive summary; confirmation that Redwood will share remediation timelines for any findings.
- Retention: two tiers requested — short-term ephemeral logs (30 days) and long-term audit trails (7 years) with an exportable format (CSV/NDJSON) and a signed integrity hash.

Attached to this thread you’ll find: a controls mapping workbook (redwood-soc2-controls-mapping.xlsx) that ties our SOC 2 controls to the specific artifacts you asked about, a short spec for audit-log exports, and an initial DPA draft (PDF) with our standard language.

Proposed next steps / owners:
1) VaultBank to confirm whether the pen test report needs to be full-scope or if an executive summary + remediation statement is sufficient (Timothy) — by 2027-01-20.
2) Redwood to produce:
   - Controls mapping (tabbed by control family) and a sample log export (Mina) — ETA 2027-01-19.
   - Redlines for DPA if any (Aditya) — ETA 2027-01-21.
3) File transfer: we can upload artifacts to the shared Drive link or provide an S3 presigned bundle — confirm preference (Sara).

If that looks right I’ll drop the mapping and the export spec into the Drive folder now and flag the HubSpot record with the timeline.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-controls-mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet), draft_DPA_redwood_vaultbank_20270118.pdf (PDF), audit-log-export-spec.md (text)
From: Timothy Lowe <timothy.lowe@vaultbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Kim <sara.kim@vaultbank.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T13:04:12-08:00
Subject: Re: VaultBank: security evidence timeline, DPA redlines, and retention checklist

Mina / Aditya —

Thanks for the concise recap — that captures it. A couple clarifications from our side after the call: 

- Pen test: an executive summary with the CVSS scores and a remediation statement is fine for the procurement packet. If there are critical/high items, we will need confirmation in writing on timelines for fixes (we may surface that with our risk committee).
- Audit logs: VaultBank security engineering needs the export to include an immutable event id, timestamp (UTC), actor, action, resource, and a HMAC signature for integrity. Prefer NDJSON with gzip.
- DPA: we’ll circulate a redline of your draft; key items we’ll focus on are subprocessors, data localization (US/EU), breach notification timing (we need 72 hours max), and liability caps for security incidents.

We prefer the shared Drive upload for artifacts; please include checksums for the bundles.

Tim

Timothy Lowe
Security Engineering Manager | VaultBank
timothy.lowe@vaultbank.com | +1 (617) 555-2266
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Timothy Lowe <timothy.lowe@vaultbank.com>, Sara Kim <sara.kim@vaultbank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-19T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: VaultBank: security evidence timeline, DPA redlines, and retention checklist

Timothy —

Got it — thanks for the precision. Short updates: 

- I uploaded the controls mapping, audit-log export spec (includes NDJSON example + gzip guidance), and a sample CSV export to the Drive folder. Filenames are: redwood-soc2-controls-mapping.xlsx, audit-log-export-spec.md, sample-audit-export-20270119.ndjson.gz. Each file has a SHA256 checksum in the folder notes.
- Pen test: we can provide either a vendor report or an internal summary depending on your procurement needs. I’ll flag this to our security team to confirm format and redact PII as needed.
- DPA: Aditya will prepare a response to your expected redlines. We note the 72-hour request; our standard is 30 days for non-security events but we have an SLA amendment path for security incidents — Aditya will propose language.

Next actions (updated):
- VaultBank to send pen test scope preference (executive summary vs full report) — owner Timothy — by 2027-01-20.
- Aditya to propose DPA redline response and an alternate breach-notification clause for security incidents — owner Aditya — by 2027-01-21.
- Mina to confirm S3 presigned + Drive upload options and share the artifact checksums in HubSpot — owner Mina — by 2027-01-19 (done).

If you’d like a short 20-minute follow-up to walk through the mapping workbook, Aditya and I can do that tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Mina

Timothy / team —

Quick note from procurement/legal side: we reviewed VaultBank’s 72-hour notification ask. We can agree to an SLA amendment for security incidents that shortens notification to 72 hours for confirmed breaches with a severity threshold; the DPA redline I’ll send will include that clause and an exhibit describing breach classification & timelines.

I’ll attach the redline by end of day 2027-01-21. Also confirming we’ll place artifacts in the shared Drive per your preference and include checksums + a small manifest file with file-level HMACs.

If VaultBank wants a walkthrough on the DPA redline and the controls mapping next Friday, propose 10:00–11:00 PT and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
